svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Inside: 130 across the floor, 220 across the lip, 180 deep.

svg.text: Four riffle rings, 6 thick, standing 12 in from the wall, the first

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Core: print the inside shape (with the ring grooves) in six

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: segments round a central key, so it comes out past the rings:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pull the key, then lift the segments inward one by one.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set four M6 stainless nuts on the shell floor over its holes,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts through from below to hold them, release-coated threads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre the core in the shell on its lip spigot; pour the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: polyurethane slowly from one side; cure as the maker says.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The liner bonds to the shell; it is replaced with the shell.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no voids at the ring lips; floor 8 mm thick over the nuts.
